entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. To ensure quality service, this call may be recorded. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support!
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit Support, my name is Alex. May I have your name and order number, please?
Yeah, it's Mark Peterson. Order number is VF90210. I need to return this VeloBand Pulse.

Okay, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 18 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
There's no issue! I just changed my mind. I want to send it back for a full refund.

I see. I do need to inform you that the VeloBand Pulse has a specific 10-day return policy due to the way the hardware activates and links to a user's account. As we are on day 18, a return for a refund is outside of that window.

ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! Ten days? That's outrageous! I barely even took it out of the box! I just don't use it, it was a complete impulse buy and now you're telling me I'm stuck with it? This is unacceptable. I want to speak to your manager right now!

I understand your frustration, Mark, and I am the senior agent authorized to handle these policy questions. A manager would have to provide you with the same information based on the 10-day activation policy.
This is a scam! I'm going to post about this on every social media platform and review site I can find. Everyone will know how VeloFit rips off its customers!

I certainly don't want you to feel stuck with a product you're not using. While a return isn't an option, we do have a solution many of our customers use in this exact situation. Have you heard of the VeloFit Resale Marketplace?
What's that? Some other way for you to take my money?

Not at all. It's our official platform that connects VeloFit users. It allows you to sell your gear directly to another member of the community. You set the price, and since the Pulse is in high demand, they often sell very quickly. It's the best way to handle a resale and get most of your money back.
So... I can just list it myself on there and someone will buy it?

That's exactly right. It's a secure process, and it ensures the new owner can register the device correctly. It's a much safer and more effective option than a standard marketplace. I can email you a direct link with step-by-step instructions on how to create a listing.
Fine. Whatever. Send me the email. I guess that's better than being stuck with a hundred-dollar paperweight.
Excellent. I've just sent that information to the email on your account. You should see it within a few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mark?
No. That's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope you have a great rest of your day.
